chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Recording scale: $50 for four sides
summary: Scale was about $50 for four sides of three minutes fifteen; the band knew the tunes from nightly playing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: I have also asked - you really have to think about this - when you recorded those records with Louis Russell, you remember how much money musicians were getting paid?
We were getting the scale, whatever it was.
What was the scale around about at that time?
How long would it take you to record one?
The time on the record was about 3 minutes and 15 seconds.
Did you go over the songs many times?
I don't know how many times. Of course, see, we knew practically all the tunes ... because we were playing on a steady job and we used to play them practically every night.
So you would get $50 for recording four songs?
A lot of those songs were written by Louis Russell and -
Yeah. Call of the Freaks - who wrote Jersey Lightning - Louis Russell.
